item.title: WW3 Timeline: Nuclear Strike on New York — The First 72 Hours
item.description:
original uri https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_arob8rgUeM
What would happen if a nuclear weapon hit New York City?
This film explores a chilling timeline of the first 72 hours after a nuclear strike on U.S. soil. From the devastating blast and fallout to NATO’s emergency response, Russia’s counter-moves, and the global chaos that follows, this scenario shows just how fragile our world really is.
